Description
com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap
 
  • Classes in com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap used by com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap
    Class
    Description
    Dn
    A Distinguished Name (DN): an ordered, most-specific-first sequence of Rdn components (RFC 4514).
    LdapEntry
    A directory entry: a distinguished name plus an ordered multimap of attribute name → values.
    LdapFilter
    Typed, immutable model of an RFC 4515 LDAP search filter.
    LdapFilterBuilder.Condition
    One filter row: an attribute matched against value using operator.
    LdapFilterBuilder.Operator
    How an attribute is matched against a value when rendering a LdapFilterBuilder.Condition.
    LdapService.ApplyResult
    Whether LdapService.applyEntry(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.List<java.lang.String>>) created a new entry or updated an existing one.
    LdapService.Entry
    A directory entry: its DN plus attributes decoded to string lists (binary values summarised).
    LdapService.Mod
    A single attribute change applied by LdapService.modifyEntry(java.lang.String, java.util.List<com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap.LdapService.Mod>).
    LdapService.ModType
    Which way a LdapService.Mod changes an attribute on an existing entry.
    LdapUrl
    A parsed LDAP URL (RFC 4516): ldap[s]://[host[:port]]/[dn][?attributes[?scope[?filter[?extensions]]]].
    LdapUrl.Extension
    One URL extension (RFC 4516 §2): an optional !-critical marker, a type, and an optional value.
    LdapUrl.Scope
    Search scope carried in the third query section of an LDAP URL (RFC 4516 §2).
    Rdn
    A single Relative Distinguished Name (RDN) — one or more type=value attribute-value assertions joined by '+' (multi-valued RDN).
    Rdn.Ava
    One type=value assertion within an RDN.
